libs.note:
BH-9818: the first `call-guard repeat` refusal of a triage shard parks its key. trp_on_repeat (bin/triage-shard.sh, after the BH-9286 note) writes state/triage-repeat/

/.park, drops the READY line and ready row through bin/queue-line-drop.sh, records one lifecycle_note and posts 1 board comment per board state through bin/lib/tracker.sh. trp_parked (bin/lib/rt/shards.sh, block `repeat park`) starts no shard for a parked key until its board entry changes. Applied by the lib itself through lib_env_apply triage-repeat-park . Doc: docs/CALL-GUARD.md.

knobs.note: 1 = a `call-guard repeat` refusal parks the key (no shard until its board entry changes), drops its READY line and posts 1 board comment. 0 = off: no park file is written and the dispatcher ignores existing ones. Code default 1, read as ${TRIAGE_REPEAT_PARK:-1}; any value but 0 or 1 falls back to 1.

Retention of the park files (state/triage-repeat/

/.park and .commented): a file older than this is deleted by trp_prune once per dispatcher tick, and the key is offered again. Code default 2592000 (30 days), read as ${TRIAGE_REPEAT_PARK_KEEP_S:-2592000}; a non-integer falls back to it, and the code clamps to min/max.
